## Service definition

`ShortcutService` declares **5 RPCs** in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` (lines 14–51):

| RPC | Proto lines |
|-----|-------------|
| `ListShortcuts` | 18–21 |
| `GetShortcut` | 24–27 |
| `CreateShortcut` | 30–36 |
| `UpdateShortcut` | 39–45 |
| `DeleteShortcut` | 48–51 |

---

## Per-RPC backend implementation map

All five RPCs share the same architecture: **business logic in one file**, with **transport adapters** in two others. There are no separate per-RPC implementation files.

### 1. `ListShortcuts`

| Layer | File | Evidence |
|-------|------|----------|
| **Business logic (primary)** | `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` | `(*APIV1Service).ListShortcuts` at line 49 |
| **Connect adapter** | `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` | `(*ConnectServiceHandler).ListShortcuts` at line 528 → delegates to `s.APIV1Service.ListShortcuts` (line 529) |
| **gRPC-Gateway (generated)** | `proto/gen/api/v1/shortcut_service.pb.gw.go` | `local_request_ShortcutService_ListShortcuts_0` calls `server.ListShortcuts` (line 73); registered at line 301 |

**MCP exposure:** `ListShortcuts` is the only ShortcutService RPC exposed via MCP (`server/router/mcp/catalog.go:30`, operation ID `ShortcutService_ListShortcuts`). Execution goes through `server/router/mcp/adapter.go`, which issues in-process HTTP requests to the same Echo routes — no separate MCP implementation.

| Transport | Registration file | Evidence |

All five RPCs persist shortcuts via `store.Store.GetUserSetting` / `UpsertUserSetting` with key `storepb.UserSetting_SHORTCUTS`. That storage layer lives in `store/user_setting.go` (and related store code), but it does **not** implement any `ShortcutService` RPC methods.

- **No other hand-written Go implementations** exist outside those two server files (confirmed by searching all `func (*...).ListShortcuts|GetShortcut|...` definitions).
